title: Find which package contains a specific file
summary: Use apt-file to search for files inside apt packages, even if they are not installed yet. This helps you identify which package provides a missing command or library.
prerequisites: apt-file is installed (sudo apt install apt-file)

steps.explain: Update the apt-file database to ensure it knows about the latest packages. This requires administrator rights.
Search for the package that contains the specified file or path.

placeholders.name: FILE
placeholders.description: The filename or path you are looking for

rollback.explain: No rollback needed for searching, but you can remove the apt-file package if you no longer need it.

warnings: The first search may take a few seconds as the database is loaded.
